At Warmy we understand that warming up a mailbox is a critically important and delicate process. Pace and precision are key to successfully prepare the mailbox for effective email marketing. Because of this we take warming up ten steps further.
Each mailbox generates a huge amount of data that can be translated to hundreds of parameters. We pick the key parameters and constantly analyze them, and feed them to our decision making engine 
‘Adeline AI’
.
Adeline decides for each and every mailbox what is the optimal warm-up schedule and plan. Making 20 million decisions a day could be a bit frustrating for a human being 😉
Improving every day by analyzing and learning from each mailbox for the same mailbox is one thing. Analyzing and improving by learning from the “crowd” of all the mailboxes for every mailbox is completely another level. Adeline watches the entire collection of mailbox in Warmy and applies new insights automatically to each mailbox. Now mailboxes really work together for the benefit of all.
Each mailbox is unique and each mailbox requires personalized care. Using the power of Artificial Intelligence, Warmy is able to provide tailor made treatment that gives maximum deliverability. Like no other.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Test all features for free. No credit card required
 
 
 
Test all features for free.

What is
Adeline AI?
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Personalized warm-up plans
 
Adeline analyzes your email sending activity and recipient behavior to craft a unique warm-up plan for each individual mailbox. This ensures that you gradually increase the sending volume without triggering spam filters, thereby maximizing email deliverability
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Predictive sending optimization
 
Adeline goes beyond warm-up by analyzing real-time sending performance and predicting optimal sending times and frequencies. This helps you maximize engagement and avoid overwhelming recipients
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
AI-powered spam risk detection
 
Adeline proactively identifies and flags emails with a high spam risk based on content, subject lines, and sender reputation. This helps you avoid landing in spam folders and ensures that your important emails reach the recipients

Frequently Asked
Questions
 
 
 
 
 
Do you offer a free trial?
 
 
 
 
 
Warmy offers a 7-day free trial. No credit card is required
 
 
 
 
 
Can I change my plan later?
 
 
 
 
 
Yes! You can upgrade or cancel your subscription plan from within your account settings at any time
 
 
 
 
 
What payment options are available?
 
 
 
 
 
We accept credit and debit cards: Visa, MasterCard, PayPal and Crypto
 
 
 
 
 
Can I share my subscription with my team?
 
 
 
 
 
Yes! You are free to add team members to share your subscription with. In this case, all the members will share the common monthly quotas provided in the plan
 
 
 
 
 
How many users can benefit from a subscription?
 
 
 
 
 
You can invite as many users as needed. The team members will share the total number of mailboxes in the plan
